description: Use this when a user asks how they have been progressing, wants to compare recent assessments, or asks whether something is working. Returns up to five recent pillar scores, overall scores, and the change between them. Do NOT use before the user has completed at least two assessments — there is no trend yet and the honest answer is that one data point is not a trend. Only returns stored derived scores, never raw answers.

limit.description: How many recent assessments to include (1-10).

name: fitness.get_progress_trend
title: Get Progress Trend
